subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw trust and adopt these 14 newly pinned third-party GitHub Action revisions in credentialed and release/security workflows?
rationale: The diff changes executable supply-chain inputs across secret-bearing workflows; this is an intentional trust and operational-risk decision, not a mechanical repository repair.

options.title: Approve the pinned revisions
options.body: Verify the upstream release provenance and action permissions, then refresh the branch against current `main` and merge after required checks pass.

options.title: Split or defer sensitive actions
options.body: Accept lower-risk setup and labeling updates separately while deferring token, release, Docker, CodeQL, and Codex-action revisions for dedicated review.

options.title: Reject this update set
options.body: Close the Dependabot PR if the workflow/security owners do not want to trust one or more replacement revisions.

recommendation.title: Approve the pinned revisions
recommendation.body: Verify the upstream release provenance and action permissions, then refresh the branch against current `main` and merge after required checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Its security-triage label identifies the applicable review lane, though a human workflow/security owner must make the final trust decision.
